newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: OSCE visits Belarus to voice concern over crisis.
newsitem.headline: OSCE visits Belarus to voice concern over crisis.

text.p: Europe's security organisation, the Organisation of Security and Cooperation in Europe (OSCE), said on Wednesday it had sent a top official to Minsk to convey its concern over the crisis in Belarus.

Secretary General Ambassador Giancarlo Aragona would meet Belarus authorities and the presidents of parliament and the constitutional court to assess the situation and explore possibilities for OSCE assistance, a statement by the Vienna-based forum said.

The former Soviet nation of 10 million people faces heightened political turmoil after hardline President Alexander Lukashenko won a controversial referendum on Tuesday to extend his powers over rival political institutions.

A team from Europe's top human rights body, the Council of Europe, on Wednesday said the referendum had been illegitimate and called on Lukashenko to "respect parliamentary democracy and the rule of law".
